name: Soslab
summary: SOS Lab Co. Ltd. specializes in pioneering Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) technology. Their advanced LiDAR sensors are deployed across a diverse range of applications, such as autonomous vehicles, robotic systems, industrial automation, critical transportation infrastructure, smart city development, and security monitoring. This company was established on June 22, 2016, by its co-founders Ji-Seong Jung, Jun-Hwan Jang, Dong-Kyu Kim, and Sung-Ui Hwang, and its primary operations are located in Gwangju, South Korea.
